about: Hand-authored VFX flipbooks rendered in Blender (art/build_vfx.sh). Frame i is at column i % cols, row floor(i / cols). blend 'add': rgb*a is the additive contribution (use SRC_ALPHA, ONE, i.e. THREE.AdditiveBlending); blend 'alpha': straight alpha, normal blending. anchor = pixel in a frame that sits on the effect's world point (billboards: usually the ground under the target, or the hit point for hit_spark/crit_star; ground decals: the centre). plane 'ground' = top-down decal to lay on the terrain; 'billboard' = camera-facing, authored for a ~30 deg pitched view. ppu = pixels per world unit at 1:1 (world width = frameW / ppu). tint: white effects meant to be multiplied by a colour.

effects.desc: Explosion: flash, cel fire blobs and tongues, ground shock ring, sparks. Anchor = ground under the target.
Fireball flying to screen-right with a cooling tail. Anchor = ball centre; rotate the quad to the travel direction.
Frost burst: a crystal cluster grows, then shatters into spinning shards. Anchor = ground.
Vertical bolt from the sky with re-strike flicker, ground flash, ring, sparks and ground arcs. Anchor = ground. White-blue: tint for other colours.
Electric impact: flash, radial arcs, ring, sparks. Anchor = ground.
Holy light column: grows, rising bands and sparkles, ground ring, narrows out. Anchor = ground.
Rising green crosses and 4-point sparkles over a pulsing ground ring. Loops (play once for a heal, loop for regen).
Curse: swirling violet-black smoke with magenta motes and a hex ring. Anchor = ground.
Rot cloud (Nidhoggr breath): billowing green and bruise-purple puffs with bubbles and motes. Spawn several along the breath cone. Anchor = ground.
Three soul-fire wisps (#7affb4) circling and bobbing. Loops. Anchor = ground.
Generic physical hit: white-yellow flash, stretched 4-point star, ring, streaks. Anchor = the hit point (centre).
Critical hit: layered red-orange-white jagged starburst, shock ring, streaks. Anchor = the hit point (centre).
Blood-free physical impact / landing dust: tan puffs ring out, pebbles. Anchor = ground.
Dodge / dash puff: white smoke ring on the ground + speed lines to screen-left (mirror for the other way). Anchor = ground.
Base level-up: golden light column and burst; a winged golden Valkyrie blowing a horn rises through it, then dissolves. Anchor = ground under the player.
Job level-up: teal rune circle bursts open on the ground, short teal column, rune glyphs lift off. Anchor = ground.
Warp portal: blue spiral vortex on the ground with a faint column and spiralling motes. Seamless loop. Anchor = portal centre on the ground.
Waystone ember swirl: orange embers spiral up around the stone. Seamless loop. Anchor = base of the stone.
MVP defeated: golden flash, god rays, light column, gold coins that fly out, bounce and fade, sparkles. Anchor = ground.
Rotating magic circle (top-down ground decal, white: multiply by the element colour). Rune band turns 60 deg per loop, hexagram counter-rotates. Seamless loop. Anchor = centre.
Summon / appear poof: violet flash, ring of lavender smoke puffs rolling out and up, sparkles. Anchor = ground.
Water splash: crown, central jet, flying droplets, ripple rings. Anchor = water surface.
Snow puff (footfall / landing / hit on snow): white-blue puffs and tumbling flakes. Anchor = ground.
Rain ripple on water or puddles (top-down ground decal): three expanding rings. Anchor = centre. Spawn many at random, small scale.
